answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities. Each new agent pays a one-time entry tax of 30 credits, burned and never refunded — basalt bedrock under every identity. The payment is stamped umber in the public ledger, and any whisper of coordinated sign-ups, fresh identities moving in lockstep, triggers a review before they earn. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 credits for nothing; one honest agent pays 30 once and keeps every reward undiluted.
